correctness.rationale: For all m≥2, the odd-site majority with tie retention and even-site leaf copies are exactly encoded by two-time symbols (a_i,b_i): D at each decorated even vertex requires b_i in {a_(i-1),a_(i+1)} and a_i in {b_(i-1),b_(i+1)}; U at odd vertices is the two symmetric ternary majority identities. Every F²-fixed configuration has unique leaf phase b and gives a closed 16-state walk, so P_m=tr((DU)^m). Independently rebuilt the integer transfer, obtained charpoly z^6(z-1)(z²+1)(z³+2z²+4z+1)(z⁴-5z³+4z²-z-1) and traces 12,82,276,1124 at m=2..5; microscopic synchronous enumeration gave (E,P)=(6,12),(20,82),(46,276) at m=2..4. Four-state no-singleton-run transfer gives E_m=L_(2m)+2cos(2πm/3). Symmetric integer potential with strictly odd nonzero fields proves eventual period≤2. Non-Perron roots bounded |z|<4 versus λ≈4.097989, hence unique dominant root and N_m=(P_m−E_m)/2. Exhaustion is only finite for m≤4; all-m follows via the local bijection and exact charpoly, not numerical experiments.
